parsed.english: For every viscosity nu > 0 there are smooth, divergence-free initial data u₀ and a smooth force f, both with Schwartz-type polynomial decay, such that for every candidate velocity v and pressure p, the pair (v, p) fails to be a smooth, finite-energy solution of the Navier–Stokes equations on ℝ³ with those data.
